tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// nā ro mkha' spyod kyi mngon rtogs bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs// dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// bskyed dang rol pa'i yum gyur pa// rdo rje rnal 'byor mar btud nas// de mnyes byed pa'i cho ga bshad// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom par 'dod pas// stan bde ba la kha nub phyogs su bltas nas ci bde bar 'dug la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la lan gsum skyabs su song nas/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi myangs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar bsam mo// de nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ bde ba dang ma bral na bdag gi don grub snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*/ bde sdug med pa'i ngang du sems snyoms par gyur cig snyam pa'i btang snyoms te tshad med pa bzhi dang*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgom/ de nas bdag gi spyi bor bla ma bsgoms la/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma dam pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// zhes brjod cing mos gus drag po byas pas bla ma rang gi lus la thim pas/ snying gi nang du chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi lte bar bam̐ las sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar dmigs nas/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros sems can thams cad la phog pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas/ sems can thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur te/ 'od zer slar 'dus te rang la thim pas rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa ni/

pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ zhal gyen du phyogs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon pas khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom/ de'i lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ mam̐ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ mgor hreṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka rnams su bsams la/ de'i thugs ka'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ 'og min gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas gnyis su med par bsams nas lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa de nyid la sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag go /bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// //rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i tshul gsum las/ bha ga'i nang du dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon du myur du 'khor ba gcig bsams nas/ de la dmigs pa rtse gcig tu gtad la/ rlung kha sbyor bsgoms pas bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur ro// yang smin mtshams kyi thad ka'i steng gi nam mkhar dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon du 'khor ba la sems gtad de yid mnyam par gzhag pas mi rtog pa'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur ro// de yang stong shas che na bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom zhing*/

bde shas che na stong pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgoms la/ zung du chud par gyur na dga' ba 'khyil pa de nyid snying ga'i bam̐ la bstim ste/ mnyam par gzhag par bya'o// rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// //sngags bzla bar 'dod na/ snying ga'i bam̐ gyi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yon skor du 'khor ba'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rgyud bskul bas de dag gi ye shes bdag gi rgyud la bzhugs pas/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa dag tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci nus pa bzlas par bya'o// gtor ma gtong ba'i tshe/ sha chang dang bcas pa'i gtor ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ thod pa chen po sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab bo// de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas la phaiṃ zhes brjod pas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ chos skyong dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams kyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye nas/ oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li ho/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya ho/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lan lnga'am bdun gyis phul nas/ ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug pa'i// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod nas/

lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin pas// bden pa des ni lha mo de dag rnams// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces bden pa'i stobs brjod nas/ gsol ba btab nas ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub gnang bar bsams nas/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod pas gshegs su gsol lo// zas za ba'i tshe kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang rnal 'byor mar dmigs pa'i lta ba nas gtum mo'i me sbar ba'i me lce'i khrod du snying gar bla ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang*/ lto bar 'jig rten pa'i tshogs thams cad dmigs nas rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa bsgoms pa'i lte bar/ oṃ bam̐ mdun phyogs nas brtsams pa'i 'dab ma rnams la rim pa bzhin ham̐ yoṃ hriṃ mam̐ hreṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa bkod pa rnams dpa' mo drug tu dmisag pa la mchod par bsam zhing*/ thog mar zhu ba'i rdzas dang*/ de nas gong bu'i rdzas kyis mchod pas mnyes par bsam zhing*/ lag pa gnyis phan tshun mnye'o// de nas lag pa g.yon pas dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar reg pas/ dpa' mo de rnams rang gi lus la thim par bsams nas lag pa g.yon pas thog mar phud kyis bla ma dang yi dam la mchod la/ de nas kha hom khung du bsams la phul bas lus kyi lha thams cad mnyes par bsam zhing bza' 'o// de nas lhag ma oṃ uts+tsheṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hās lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin no// spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyi rol gyi snang ba thams cad mchod pa'i lha mor dmigs pa rnams kyis 'dod yon gyi mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ kha na ma tho ba med par ci bde bar spyod do// nyal ba'i tshe/ snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas phyi rol gyi 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bsdus nas rang la thim/

rang gi lus kyang snying ga'i bam̐ la thim/ bam̐ stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang la nyal lo// ldang ba'i tshe stong pa nyid kyi ngang las rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa'i thugs ka'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad gsal bar dmigs nas ldang bar bya'o// de ltar yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor la rtag tu gnas na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid kyis rjes su bzung nas mkha' la spyod pa'i go 'phang myur du thob ste/ go 'phang de la brten nas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dngos grub kyang myur du thob par 'gyur ba nyid do// gsung rab zab mo'i snying po'i tshul// rnal 'byor ma dpal sgrub pa'i thabs// dad ldan shes rab rab gsal ba// go go can gyis gsol btab nas// lung dang man ngag dang ldan pa// sngags 'chang 'phags pa zhes byas sbyar// dge ba de yis 'gro ba kun// bde ba'i dpal gyis 'byor gyur nas// mkha' spyod mchog gis rol gyur cig /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' la spyod pa'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun nā ro pa'i man ngag dpal sa skya pa las brgyud pa 'di ni sa mo sbrul gyi lo gdu bu'i zla ba la shang tor sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
